welcome.headline: Understand every line.
welcome.copy: WordWise turns any film's script into a vocabulary list — learn the key words before you watch, in the language you're studying.

usernameStep.title: What should we call you?
usernameStep.sub: Your username shows up on leaderboards and in your family plan. You can change it any time in Settings.
usernameStep.saveFailed: Could not save the username. Please try again.

placementStep.eyebrow: Quick placement · word {{index}} of up to {{total}}
placementStep.title: How well do you know…

rating.knowSub: Could use it in a sentence

explanation.A1: You're just starting out. We'll begin your reels with the highest-frequency A1–A2 words and build from there.
explanation.A2: You know everyday basics. We'll start your reels with A2–B1 vocabulary and adapt as you go.
explanation.B1: You recognise common words but miss nuance. We'll start your reels with B1–B2 vocabulary and adapt as you go.
explanation.B2: You follow most dialogue. We'll start your reels with B2–C1 vocabulary so you keep being challenged.
explanation.C1: You're fluent in the everyday. We'll focus your reels on C1–C2 words — the rare, precise ones.
explanation.C2: You're near-native. We'll surface the rarest C2 vocabulary and idioms films throw at you.

filmStep.title: Pick your first film
filmStep.sub: We'll build a word list from its script — start with one you'd love to understand.

goalStep.title: Set your daily goal
goalStep.sub: You can change this any time. Consistency beats intensity.

setIntro.headline: Learn 5 words from this film
setIntro.subhead: So when you watch it with subtitles later, you'll actually follow every line.
